title: Listen and Choose a Response — Weekend Plans

questions.stem: Why don't we go see that new movie tonight?

options.A: Because I saw it last night.
options.C: I have to work late, but how about Saturday?
options.D: Yes, it's been a long night.

questions.explanation: 'Why don't we' is a suggestion, and offering another day is a natural counter-suggestion. One option treats it as a real 'why' question.
questions.speaker: f4
